headline: Held public hearing on school bus and property surveillance camera policies with no public attendees.
summary: The Board of Education held a public hearing to review Policies ECAF and EEAA on camera and audio/video surveillance on school buses and school property. No members of the public attended the hearing.
plain_text:
1 
 
BOE PUBLIC HEARING 
MONDAY, AUGUST 24, 2026 
NHS NORTH BOARD ROOM 
 
 
The Board of Education held a public hearing at the NHS North Board Room on Monday, August 24, 2026.  Ms. 
Bishop called the meeting to order at 5:35 pm.  
 
Present: Ms. Giglio, Mr. Johnson, Ms. Raymond, Mr. Salvi, Ms. Lamphier, Ms. Lopez, and Ms. Bishop 
 
Also Present: Dr. Andrade, Mr. O’Rourke 
 
 
The BOE Public Hearing was held for the review and public comment on Nashua School Board Policies ECAF - 
Use of Cameras on School Buses (Surveillance and Other Audio or Video Recording by the District) and EEAA– 
Video and Audio Surveillance on School Property.  
 
No attendees for the public hearing on the reading of Policy ECAF and Policy EEAA. 
 
The public hearing concluded. 
 
Ms. Giglio moved, seconded by Ms. Lopez, to adjourn at 5:42 pm.  Motion passes 7-0. 
 
 
Submitted by Tara C. Kinsella
